title: Café Rise 160 - The Halloween Episode
description:
Cafe Rise 160: the Halloween episode! 🎃 Josh (as Bob Rosalanturn) and Rob (as the original Robert from England, Freddy Krueger himself) recap Free Flight 2 and what's coming in Free Flight 3, then dig into why small studios stand to gain the most from AI. Rob explains how he rebuilt the old SkyCars.

Then a first look at the Black Friday release plans: AI companions, the economy, below-surface mining, farming, low-level NPCs, the blue track and building on land. This week's leak, and we finish with your questions and a land marketplace update.

🔥 IN THIS EPISODE
• Free Flight 2: racing quests, Solace shooting range quests, performance fixes and enhanced volumetric clouds
• The surprise Hover Sport release, which took a good eight hours of coding from a 5:30 a.m. message
• Free Flight 3 on the way: Hover Sport course expansion, faster hover bikes, new Burger Barn quests
• Acceleration: why a small studio with solid systems, processes and tools benefits the most from AI
• Small studios vs AAA: Josh and Rob don't fully agree
• Black Friday targets: AI companions, economy, below-surface mining, farming (16 meshes per crop, 147 crops planned), NPCs, blue track, building on land
• LEAK: complete the Halloween Shadows quest and you'll be able to mint the bunny hat as a POA (optional)
• New Aerotrails and hover bike quests, plus a lore-driven quest system v2 next year
• Q&A: how we handle your questions, and when the Founders Bundle air racer arrives

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/infinityrisinggame

Infinity Rising is an open-world sandbox MMO and multiverse simulator set between Cornucopias, the nation in the sky, the fractured Earth below, and the unknown worlds beyond. Born from the aftermath of the Calamity—a quantum storm that shattered reality—players rebuild civilization under vast domes powered by advanced quantum tech. 

Guided by “The Messenger,” you’ll explore, gather, craft, trade, and defend in a player-driven economy across land, sky, and beyond. Quantum Rifts, mysterious anomalies tied to The Prophet and The Terra, challenge survival and progress as players rise into infinite possibilities. Whether you craft, farm, fight, or build empires, every choice shapes the future of the Cornucopias Republic—humanity’s last beacon of hope. 

Infinity Rising is a call to ascend without end—world, player, and technology together.

0:00 Intro
0:42 Welcome to Cafe Rise 160: the Halloween episode
2:05 What are you drinking today?
2:31 Free Flight 3 is on the way
3:51 Free Flight 2 recap: new quests
4:59 Performance fixes and volumetric clouds
5:55 The surprise Hover Sport release
7:24 What's next: Hover Sport expansion and Burger Barn quests
8:49 Acceleration: why small studios gain the most from AI
13:10 Rewriting the SkyCars with Claude: 1,400 nodes down to 110
15:57 Is gaming dead? AI, solo devs and new studios
17:53 Small studios vs AAA: who accelerates the most?
22:44 Black Friday release: AI companions, economy and mining
24:15 Farming: 16 meshes per crop
26:55 Low-level NPCs, the blue track and building on land
28:24 Leak: the Halloween bunny hat becomes a POA
31:13 New quests: Aerotrails and hover bike challenges
32:40 Q&A: Is there a better way to ask questions?
35:09 Q&A: When will the Founders Bundle air racer arrive?
36:58 Land marketplace update
37:52 Outro
